verdict.rationale: Gusto has no documented bulk export or offboarding feature. You can pull your own data programmatically in an open format, though: the official CLI connects to your account via OAuth and emits a stable JSON envelope with pagination cursors for employees, contractors, jobs, compensation, payroll and timesheets. The paginated REST API returns JSON, and the account-level MCP server also gives scoped access to your data. Missing for 10: a documented complete-account export (all data categories, including tax filings, documents and historical payrolls), a defined export format or bulk download, and any guidance on account closure or migrating away.
